dp2331_table_verification.quantity_identity: (1/M) * sum_m (t_hat_e^(m) - t_e), in months. Table 2's caption calls it a bias; the section 5.2 text calls it an averaged delay. Same statistic, two names.
dp2331_table_verification.verbatim_text_p20: the succesful [sic] detection rate of PSY (multiple) is lower (75% versus 84%) and the bias in the estimated bubble origination date is larger (12.20 months versus 7.56 months)
errors_found_in_review: section 7.3 attributed 7.56/12.20 to Table 1; they are in Table 2 p.21
section 7.3 labelled them 'origination delay' without the 0.84->0.75 SDR cost
section 7.3 gave the FWER-controlled collapse SD as 1.72; DP 2331 gives 1.71

section 7.3 called the FWER-controlled critical values a 'multiple-window bootstrap'; DP 2331 section 5.1 simulates max_s PSY_s from x_t = x_{t-1} + e_t and takes the 95th percentile, over a single control window T_w = T
